review.summary: The merged batch contains one safe native-runtime locale fix. No zero-origin adaptation or source changes are needed.

commits.subsystems: Native runtime bootstrap and platform locale initialization in src/support/libsupportinit.c; callers inspected include jl_init_, jl_repl_entrypoint, jl_resolve_sysimg_location, and flisp lisp_init.
commits.indexing_implications: LC_COLLATE in libsupport_init is a C locale-category enum, not a collection position, dimension, sentinel, or Joolia index; it must remain unchanged. The nearby codeset value is a byte offset into the locale string and is unrelated to collection indexing. The added setlocale(LC_COLLATE, "C") preserves zero-origin behavior and does not affect C/LLVM/foreign ABI indices.
commits.adaptations: None. The existing Joolia port has no change to this file between 0d7752bee1fe8d007fe5b9d276904487d092f919 and b168f1971de6fbb958d96ec27d878fef515c0874. The resulting merged code places collation normalization after user-locale adoption and numeric-locale normalization, before CTYPE handling, preserving upstream intent while avoiding locale-dependent C++ collation failures.
commits.tests: Recommended, not executed: rebuild the runtime and run the affected Windows configuration under a non-C collation locale; verify a fresh process reports LC_COLLATE as C and successfully exercises a C++ std::regex bracket matcher linked to the bundled runtime. Run the native static-analysis targets for src/support/libsupportinit.c, then the required python3 contrib/ci/run.py --jobs 4 gate. Existing test/misc.jl locale coverage and test/regex.jl should be included as regression smoke checks; no Julia regression file needed because no Joolia semantic adaptation was made.
